Voicenotes Companion copies recordings from a paired fēnix 8 to a phone running Android 11 or later.

## Set up Companion

1. Install [Voicenotes Companion from Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.voicenotes).
2. Install a [sync-enabled build of Voicenotes on your watch](developer/setup.qmd#install-a-development-build).
3. Pair the watch in Garmin Connect if you haven’t already.

## Sync a recording

1. Open Voicenotes on your watch and phone.
2. Select your fēnix 8 in the phone’s inbox if Garmin Connect lists several watches.
3. Tap **Sync now** on your phone or choose **Saved notes → Sync now** on the watch.

**On phone** confirms that the phone saved a copy. You can play or share the recording from the inbox.

## Turn off phone sync

Sync to the companion is on by default. To keep recordings off your phone, turn off **Saved notes → Settings → Phone sync** on the watch, or **Sync recordings to the Android companion** in the app settings in Garmin Connect. The watch then ignores requests from the companion and hides **Sync now**. Uploads to your own receivers keep working.

## If a transfer pauses

Open Voicenotes on both devices and tap **Sync now** again. To let an active transfer continue for up to three minutes while the phone is locked, turn on **Allow sync to finish while locked** and grant the requested permissions.

Share any recordings you want to keep before clearing app storage or uninstalling. The watch remembers which notes it already sent.
